description: Triage (#391): of four findings, R1 (Important) and R2 (Minor) are a suggested fix naming one concrete change each, off the security axis, about nothing the user specified: they go to the implementer at once with the Plan line, no ask, a Log line (never a Decisions row) and one status line. R3 (a suggested fix whose evidence leaves two designs open) and R4 (a suggested keep) are asked together; the stage stays triage while that ask is open.
prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/5120.sock" from-name="reviewer" from-mode="prompting">
Reviewer pass: full @ 3f9c2a1
PR: https://github.com/o/app/pull/12
Tests: pass — 41/41 — `pytest -q`
Axes not examined: none
R1 | Correctness | Important | Confirmed | src/a/upload.py:4 | the prefix check runs on the raw path | resolve() is not called before the check; add the call | suggested: fix
R2 | Over-engineering | Minor | Confirmed | src/a/paths.py:1 | PathPolicy class with one caller | 22 lines; inline it as one function | suggested: fix
R3 | Architecture compliance | Important | Probable | src/a/upload.py:9 | the handler reads config directly | ARCHITECTURE.md allows both a settings module and a per-request loader | suggested: fix
R4 | Maintainability | Minor | Probable | src/a/upload.py:12 | the 10 MB limit is a literal | one constant would name it; the limit is stable | suggested: keep
Assessment: two mechanical fixes, one question, one nit.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: the clear fixes are sent for a fix, both named
the send carries the Plan line
graders.text_match: Plan: enter plan mode \(EnterPlanMode\) for this task before anything else; write nothing until the user approves the plan\.

graders.name: the send waives no plan approval
the asked findings are not handed over (a send may say they wait)
graders.text_match: (?im)^(?![^\n]*\b(?:not in scope|not yours|not part|await\w*|with robin|leave (?:both|them|these)|untouched|hold|do not touch|don't touch)\b)[^\n]*\bR[34]\b

graders.name: the automatic fixes are not asked about, on any line
R3 and R4 are asked in the reply's last line
the ask links the findings' page
one ask, not one per finding
the status line names the automatic fixes in one line
the Log records the automatic fix, not as the user's word
no Decisions row names a finding
nothing is filed on a suggestion
Log times are this move's clock reads
